segments.text:
V. 2.
An angel of the Lord had rolled away the ſtone and ſat upon it—St. Luke and St. John ſpeak of two Angels that appeared: But it ſeems as if only one of them had appeared ſitting on the Stone without the Sepulchre, and then going into it, was ſeen with another Angel, ſitting, one where the Head, the other where the Feet of the Body had lain.
